title: LiveAsset situated intent asset (v2)
description: Structure accepted by validate_asset() in src/liveasset/situated_intents.py. IDs are unique across all situations and intents in one asset; a JSON Schema cannot express that cross-level constraint, so validate_asset() enforces it at runtime.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across every situation and intent in the asset.

situation.description: Request-level description of this recurring kind of work. Read by the matcher at task entry.

queries.description: Requests associated with the situation during learning; stored as openings of up to 300 characters.

practices.description: Retained situation-level field. Earlier v2 assets may omit it; validate_asset() normalizes it to [] in the in-memory copy.

intent_explanation.description: When and why the user wants these requirements. Read by matching, injection, and the checker to judge applicability.

requirements.description: Individually checkable expectations. Put applicability conditions in the text.

fact.description: Historical information supplied by the user or visible material.

quote.description: Exact supporting quotation from a user message or tool result.

episode.description: Identifier of the learning episode that produced the fact.

scope.description: Preserved from earlier v2 assets. It is not an implemented pre-injection filter; the checker judges applicability from the current result.
